MEMO: Year-One Vendor Selection
To: CFO
From: Priya, Procurement Owner
Subject: Approval to Sign – Vendor Recommendation

Constraint Summary:
Year-one budget ceiling is $100,000, including setup. SSO is mandatory before production.

Comparison:
Alpha: $72,000 annual subscription plus $20,000 one-time setup. Required SSO is available. Year-one total $92,000.
Beta: $60,000 annual subscription plus $10,000 setup. Required SSO is unavailable and has no committed delivery date. Year-one total $70,000.
Both vendors meet the other stated requirements.

Evaluation:
Alpha meets budget and mandatory SSO constraint. Beta meets budget but fails mandatory SSO constraint.

Recommendation: Approve Alpha for year one. CFO approval is needed before signing.
